contact.name: Jerrold A. Frost Sr. “Jack” Frost
contact.evidence_quote: Michigan CAT was founded as Michigan Tractor and Machinery Co. in 1944 by Jerrold A. Frost Sr. “Jack” Frost served as Chief Executive Officer until 1971 when his son-in-law, Mark Jung, was elected President. His son, Jerrold M. Jung, was elected president on July 18, 1988 and held this post until January 31, 2011 upon sale to MacAllister Machinery Co. Inc. In June of 2025, Michigan CAT was officially merged under the MacAllister Machinery brand.
